notes.title: Control Configuration + Faster Loading + Russian Support
notes.content:
This major update includes:
[list]
[*]Control configuration for most controls, excluding the WASD keys and mouse for player movement. You can now use E to grab objects.
[*]Faster initial loading time by adding small loading sessions throughout the game.
[*]Russian support for menus and subtitles.
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Level 11 Map Change
notes.content: To anyone stuck at level 11 after getting the cube to the button, it seems there was an unintended way to bypass part of the map. I've made some changes to hopefully prevent it. Please try again now. Apologies about that.
